forms.purpose: Application for Conversion of Section 8 Company into any Other Kind
forms.whenRequired: Section 8 companies seeking conversion to Private Limited or other type
forms.timeline: File to Regional Director within 3 months of Special Resolution
forms.penalty: Conversion without RD approval void; company continues to be Section 8
forms.notes: CRITICAL: This is Regional Director approval — NOT NCLT. NOT SPICe+. NOT simple MoA/AoA alteration. INC-32 (SPICe+) is WRONG. Section 122 is irrelevant. Section 115TD exit tax applies if Section 12A registered. Creditor consent mandatory. Assets must be transferred to another Sec 8 company or IEPF as directed by RD.
steps: Board Resolution — approve conversion, altered MoA/AoA, fix SGM date
Pass Special Resolution at SGM — conversion + altered MoA/AoA
File MGT-14 within 30 days of SR
Within 1 week of filing application: publish INC-19 notice in 1 English + 1 vernacular newspaper
Intimate ROC, Income Tax Dept, Charity Commissioner, sectoral regulators
File INC-18 to Regional Director with: SR copy, altered MoA/AoA, audited FS, asset-liability statement, creditor list with written consent, director declaration, proof of publication
RD hearing if objections received
After RD approval order: file INC-20 within 30 days
ROC issues fresh Certificate of Incorporation as Private Limited Company
Address Section 115TD exit tax liability (if Sec 12A registered)

forms.purpose: Notice for Conversion of Section 8 Company (Newspaper Publication)
forms.whenRequired: Mandatory step for Section 8 company conversion — within 1 week of filing INC-18
forms.timeline: Within 1 week of filing application to Regional Director
forms.penalty: Non-publication: application to RD may be rejected
forms.notes: Must be published in: (1) one English language newspaper and (2) one vernacular language newspaper — both in the principal district where RO is situated. Must also intimate: ROC, Income Tax authority, Charity Commissioner if registered, any sectoral regulator.
steps: Draft notice per Form INC-19
Publish in one English newspaper (principal district of RO)
Publish in one vernacular newspaper (principal district of RO)
Send notice to ROC
Send notice to jurisdictional Income Tax officer
Send notice to Charity Commissioner (if registered as charity)
Preserve newspaper clippings as proof
Attach proof of publication with INC-18 application

forms.purpose: Intimation of Conversion — Post Regional Director Approval
forms.whenRequired: After Regional Director approves Section 8 conversion
forms.timeline: Within 30 days of RD order
forms.penalty: Late filing: additional fee; non-filing: conversion certificate not issued
forms.notes: Filed after RD grants approval. ROC then issues fresh Certificate of Incorporation as Private Limited Company. Company must also address compliance requirements: (1) update name (add 'Private Limited'), (2) file altered MoA/AoA, (3) comply with private company requirements going forward.
steps: Receive RD order approving conversion
File INC-20 on MCA V3 within 30 days
ROC issues fresh Certificate of Incorporation
Update company name in all records
Address tax compliance: Section 12A/80G cancellation, Section 115TD exit tax
Inform all stakeholders of conversion
Update bank accounts, contracts, licenses
